name: Acro LLC
about:
Acro LLC is based in Dover, Delaware, where it has operated in the medical supply sector for more than twenty years. The privately owned business does not disclose its founding year or the names of its founders, but it presents itself as a long-standing participant in the healthcare distribution network.

The company supplies a wide range of FDA-certified products, from disposable single-use items to hospital beds. It does not manufacture these goods; instead, it acts as a distributor and supply-chain partner, managing inventory and logistics to meet the needs of healthcare facilities.

Acro serves hospitals, clinics, and other healthcare providers, focusing on the medical and healthcare industries. Its stated mission is to connect healthcare workers with the equipment the healthcare system requires to deliver patient care, positioning the firm as a link between product availability and clinical demand.

According to the company, its daily work centers on bridging gaps in the supply chain so that frontline staff have the tools they need to operate safely and efficiently.
